content: go.work (Go 1.18+) lets multiple independent Go modules (each own go.mod) be developed together without replace directives: go work init ./services/identity ./services/booking ./pkg/events etc. go.work is a local dev convenience only - not committed for CI/prod in the strict sense (though many repos do commit it for reproducible local dev); each service still builds standalone from its own go.mod for Docker images. Fits monorepos where services share internal packages (pkg/*) and need cross-module editing without publishing intermediate versions.
